features.name: normalized_price_range
features.description: Measures the volatility of the market relative to its opening price, providing a scale-normalized distance metric for KNN.
features.expected_model_benefit: Improves neighborhood geometry by grouping markets with similar relative volatility profiles.

features.name: price_position_in_range
features.description: Calculates where the opening price sits within the high-low range, normalizing the price action to a standard scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Allows KNN to compute meaningful distances between markets based on intra-range price positioning regardless of absolute price.

features.name: log_volume_per_trade
features.description: Computes the logarithmic volume per trade, acting as a normalized proxy for average trade size.
features.expected_model_benefit: Helps the distance metric differentiate between retail-driven (many small trades) and whale-driven (few large trades) markets.

features.name: log_volume_normalized
features.description: Min-max normalized logarithmic volume to ensure volume differences do not dominate the KNN distance calculation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents the volume feature from disproportionately skewing Euclidean or Manhattan distances.

features.name: high_volatility_prototype_dist
features.description: Euclidean distance to an unsupervised prototype representing a high-volatility, high-volume market state.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a direct spatial feature that clusters highly active and volatile markets together.

features.name: low_activity_prototype_dist
features.description: Euclidean distance to an unsupervised prototype representing a dormant market (zero volume, minimal trades).
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a continuous similarity score to low-activity states, improving neighborhood resolution for illiquid markets.

features.name: platform_market_interaction
features.description: A normalized interaction term between platform ID and logarithmic market ID.
features.expected_model_benefit: Embeds platform and market chronology into a bounded continuous space suitable for distance calculations.

features.name: price_trend_proxy
features.description: A binary indicator mapped to -1 or 1 representing whether the open price is above or below the midpoint of the high-low range.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a standardized categorical distance penalty for markets with opposing intra-range skews.

features.name: trade_density_score
features.description: Ratio of logarithmic trade count to the price range, indicating how densely traded a specific price band is.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights markets with high friction or strong consensus, grouping them effectively in the feature space.

features.name: market_liquidity_cluster
features.description: Categorizes the market into liquidity clusters (e.g., 0 for illiquid, 1 for moderate, 2 for highly liquid) based on volume and trade count profiles.
features.expected_model_benefit: Aids KNN in grouping similar liquidity regimes by providing a discrete, ordinal cluster indicator.

features.name: price_extremity_index
features.description: Assesses whether the open price is at an extreme (near 0 or 1) versus the middle (near 0.5), providing a normalized distance metric to the boundaries.
features.expected_model_benefit: Improves similarity matching by grouping markets that are near resolution (extreme prices) versus highly uncertain markets (middle prices).

features.name: platform_behavior_similarity
features.description: Evaluates how closely the market's price and volume dynamics match the typical behavior of its respective platform.
features.expected_model_benefit: Serves as a similarity score for neighborhood weighting, allowing the model to penalize anomalous markets within a platform.
